hints.あ: A cross with a big looping body: an apple skewered on a stick. Ah!
hints.い: Two strokes side by side, like the two i's in 'ii'.
hints.う: A small dash over a curve: a U lying on its side, wearing a cap.
hints.え: A dash, then a zigzag with a kicking tail: an energetic dancer.
hints.お: Like あ, plus a dot flying off to the right: an oar splashing.
hints.か: A blade with a spark beside it: ka! a karate chop.
hints.き: A key: two bars across the shaft and a curl at the bottom.
hints.く: A beak opening to the right: a cuckoo calling ku.
hints.け: A post, then a bar with a long tail: a keg with a tap.
hints.こ: Two short worms lying parallel: a cozy couple.
hints.さ: Like き with one bar taken away. Sa: subtract a bar.
hints.し: One long fishhook: she is fishing.
hints.す: A bar with a loop swinging down the middle: a swing.
hints.せ: A long bar on two legs, one curving: a settee bench.
hints.そ: One zigzag stroke ending in a wave: sewing thread.
hints.た: A t on the left and こ on the right: ta.
hints.ち: A cross over a backwards 5: a cheerleader, arms out.
hints.て: A bar curling down: an outstretched hand (te means hand).
hints.と: A thorn poking into a toe.
hints.な: A cross plus a knotted loop: a knot in a rope.
hints.に: A stick beside two short lines: a knee next to こ.
hints.ぬ: め with a loop at the end: noodles twirled on a fork.
hints.ね: A stick and a wavy body ending in a curl: a cat's tail (neko).
hints.の: One swirl, like a no-entry sign drawn in a single stroke.
hints.は: Like け, but the right side ends in a loop: ha ha, a big belly laugh.
hints.ひ: A wide grin with a dimple: hee hee.
hints.ふ: Four scattered strokes: Mount Fuji with clouds around it.
hints.へ: A single mountain peak: shout hey from the top.
hints.ほ: は with an extra bar on top: a house with one more floor.
hints.ま: Two bars and a loop at the bottom: mama holding a baby.
hints.み: A loop with a trailing tail, crossed by a slash: a music note, mi.
hints.む: A cross, a loop and a dot: a cow's head going moo.
hints.め: Crossed strokes forming an eye (me means eye).
hints.も: A fishhook with two bars: catch more fish.
hints.や: A curved horn, a dot and a long slash: a yak's horn.
hints.ゆ: A loop with a line running through it: a fish swimming in a U.
hints.よ: A yo-yo hanging from a short bar.
hints.ら: A short tick over a curve: a rabbit sitting, one ear up.
hints.り: Two reeds standing, the right one longer.
hints.る: ろ with a loop at the end: a road ending in a roundabout.
hints.れ: Like ね, but the end kicks out instead of curling: a leg kicking.
hints.ろ: A winding road: る without the loop.
hints.わ: Like ね, but it ends in an open round belly: wa, wide.
hints.を: A person swinging a bat: whoa!
hints.ん: A lowercase n with a tail.
hints.ア: An axe: a hooked blade and a handle.
hints.イ: A person leaning on a post: an easel.
hints.ウ: う with a roof: a cap over a box.
hints.エ: An elevator shaft between two floors.
hints.オ: A cross with a slash: an oar dipping into water.
hints.カ: か without the spark: just the karate chop.
hints.キ: き in straight lines: a key with two bars.
hints.ク: A hook with a short tick: a cook's ladle.
hints.コ: Two sides of a box: a corner.
hints.サ: A bar held up by two posts, one curving: a saddle.
hints.シ: Two dots, then a stroke rising from the bottom left: she smiles. (ツ falls from the top.)
hints.ス: A bar, then a slash with a kick: a sumo wrestler's stance.
hints.ソ: A dot, then a long stroke falling from the top: a sewing needle. (ン rises from the bottom.)
hints.タ: ク with a stroke inside: a taco with filling.
hints.チ: ち straightened out: a cheerleader holding a pole.
hints.ツ: Two dots, then a long stroke falling from the top right: tsunami spray. (シ rises.)
hints.テ: Two bars and a drooping stroke: a telephone pole.
hints.ト: A totem pole with one branch.
hints.ナ: A cross with a long leaning leg: a knife.
hints.ヌ: ス with a slash through it: noodles caught by chopsticks.
hints.ネ: A dot, a fold and two legs: a nest on a branch.
hints.ハ: Two strokes spreading apart: ha, a puff of breath.
hints.ヒ: A bar with a bending line: the heel of a shoe.
hints.フ: One folded stroke: the top of Mount Fuji.
hints.ヘ: Same as へ: a mountain peak.
hints.ホ: A cross with two little legs: a holy cross.
hints.マ: A fold with a dot: mama's apron pocket.
hints.ム: A pointed nose with a nostril: a cow, moo.
hints.モ: Two bars and a hook: more bars than も has curves.
hints.ヤ: や in straight lines: a yak's horn.
hints.ユ: A U-turn sitting on a base: you turn.
hints.ヨ: A backwards E: a yo-yo string coiled up.
hints.ラ: A bar over フ: a rabbit's ear over its head.
hints.リ: り in straight lines: two reeds.
hints.ル: Two roots, the right one kicking up.
hints.レ: One stroke down and up, like a check mark: reh.
hints.ワ: A corner with a waterfall pouring down: wa.
hints.ヲ: フ with an extra bar: whoa, arms out.
hints.ン: Like ソ, but the long stroke sweeps up from the bottom: n.

verbs: to sleep, to go to bed
to rest, to take a day off
